title: SCH-CNT-002 resource definition
description: A resource definition. The project-owned typed validator in src/MechaMiner.Content/Categories/ remains authoritative; this schema is the draft 2020-12 mirror kept for editor and tool interoperability, and a fixture corpus proves the two reach the same accept/reject verdict on every structural case. See content/schemas/README.md. One schema with a resource_class discriminator rather than two directories: splitting the layout would have to be atomic across tooling, schemas, importers and clean-checkout tests, which is not worth paying for eight files.

id.title: A stable, case-sensitive ASCII content ID

resource_class.description: Which of the three resource shapes this definition is. The token is the union discriminator: it decides whether canonical_letter and resonance_behavior are required or forbidden.

canonical_letter.description: The player-visible letter. Doc 40 lists the ID and the canonical letter as two fields; the letter is what lets a weapon recipe of opaque resource IDs still be checked against the weapon's own W-xy suffix.

inventory_scope.description: Whether units survive the end of a run.

persistence_class.description: The persistence class, as a token rather than the sentence that was standing in for one.

maximum_safe_count.description: The maximum count a run may safely hold. No accepted document states one for any resource, so all eight omit the key and the compiler materializes the documented default.

minimum.derivation: the section makes integer currency and rank values integral in source; a count of things that exist begins at one, because a count of zero is the absence of the field rather than a value of it

shared_economy_tier.description: Whether the material sits in the shared economy tier.

resonance_behavior.title: A specialized material's resonance behavior
resonance_behavior.description: Present on a specialized material and forbidden on a currency: neither common ore nor Hyper Gold has a geode that projects a field.

behavior_kind.description: The registered resonance behavior. Doc 40 requires resonance behavior registration where applicable; no definition carries a token yet, so the field is validated but not required, and becomes required in the change that mints the vocabulary. A lower-kebab-case token. Whether it resolves to exactly one registered behavior descriptor is the behavior registry's check and is deliberately not asserted here.

modifier_percent.description: The magnitude in percentage points. The direction is carried by modifier_direction, so the magnitude itself is positive.

exclusiveMinimum.derivation: a share expressed in percentage points; zero would be the absence of the entry rather than a value of it, so it is excluded rather than admitted as a share of none

maximum.derivation: a share expressed in percentage points; one hundred of them is the whole, and a share cannot exceed the thing it is a share of

modifier_direction.description: Which way the modifier moves the statistic.

edge_case_rule.description: The edge case this material's field resolves.

secured_only_by_mission_extraction.description: Whether units are banked only by extracting.

increased_by_power_ups.description: Whether account PowerUps increase the yield.

version.title: A positive integer version
version.description: The initial schema_version and content_version of every first-authored definition is 1.

minimum.derivation: the initial value of every first-authored definition is 1 and both versions only ever increment, so no valid version is below 1; there is no upper bound because a definition may be revised without limit

name_key.title: Localization key for the player-facing name

summary_key.title: Localization key for the concise player-facing summary

tags.title: Closed query and tooling vocabulary
tags.description: The vocabulary starts empty, so [] is the only accepted value.

presentation_id.title: Logical presentation entry
presentation_id.description: Omitted when a definition never appears in-world. No accepted document mints a grammar for a presentation ID, and inventing one for a category with zero members would be structure ahead of need, so the only constraint is that an authored value is not the empty string.

minLength.rationale: not a capacity bound: the empty string is what the compiler materializes for an omitted field, so an authored empty string would be a second way to say 'absent'. 1 is the smallest length that excludes it

allOf.title: canonical_letter and resonance_behavior follow resource_class
allOf.description: A specialized material carries both; a currency carries neither. Expressed as a two-arm oneOf because the alternative - one nullable field per case - is the encoding doc 40 removes by banning null.
